title: The Laziest AI Side Hustle Anyone Can Start Right Now
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The host promotes Fish Audio S2 Pro and bases the tutorial on it; no sponsorship or affiliate disclosure is stated in the transcript.

stated_problem.quote: Realtors know this, but they can't do anything about it until now because they can't leave voicemails in languages other than English.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Multilingual realtor voicemail service
idea.one_liner: Create personalized, voice-cloned voicemails in clients’ languages for realtors, charging recurring fees or setup fees.
idea.offer: A library of translated, voice-cloned voicemail templates for property alerts and client updates.
idea.revenue_model: Monthly subscription and optional setup fee; a one-time package is also suggested.

key_quotes.quote: Realtors know this, but they can't do anything about it until now because they can't leave voicemails in languages other than English.
We're going to solve that problem for them and charge $200 to $500 a month to do so.
After we clone their voice, we can generate a library of pre-recorded voicemails that relate to certain properties that they may be listing or that their buyers may be interested in buying.

claims.claim: The speaker says 40% of home buyers speak a language other than English at home.
claims.quote: Did you know that 40% of home buyers speak a language other than English at home?

claims.claim: The speaker says the share is over 50% in some named markets.
claims.quote: And in some markets like Dallas, New York, LA, Miami, that number is over 50%.

claims.claim: The proposed service price is $200 to $500 per month.
claims.quote: We're going to solve that problem for them and charge $200 to $500 a month to do so.

claims.claim: The service can clone a voice from 10 to 60 seconds of audio.
claims.quote: The three things that matter the very most for this business is number one, you can clone any voice from as little as 10 to 60 seconds of audio.

claims.claim: The tool supports over 80 languages with the same voice and tone.
claims.quote: Number two, it works in 80 plus languages with the same voice and same tone.

claims.claim: The tool has over 15,000 emotion tags.
claims.quote: And number three, there's over 15,000 emotion tags that let you control how the voice sounds, whether it's warm or excited, professional, or whatever the message may need.

claims.claim: The speaker spent $15 on 250,000 credits and had 249,577 credits remaining after two recordings.
claims.quote: So to give you an idea of how much it cost me to make these two recordings so far, I spent 15 bucks on 250,000 credits and I still have 249,577 credits left.

claims.claim: The speaker estimates those recordings cost 3 cents or less.
claims.quote: So it cost me like 3 cents or less to make these.

claims.claim: Five hypothetical realtors paying $300 monthly would yield $1,500 per month and $18,000 per year.
claims.quote: So, if you had five realtors paying 300 bucks a month. That's 1,500 bucks a month recurring, $18,000 a year.

claims.claim: Ten hypothetical realtors would yield $3,000.
claims.quote: 10 realtors, you're at 3,000 from a service you could deliver from your laptop.

acquisition_channels.details: The launch plan says to text real estate agents already in the founder's phone or social contacts.
Meet agents for lunch, show them a voice-cloned sample, visit broker offices, and offer a free training session with food and a flyer or QR code.
Use testimonials and reviews from early customers to help win later clients.
Follow up with offices and acquaintances after the initial meeting or training.

ideas.delivery: Collect or obtain an authorized voice sample, generate translated scripts and cloned audio, organize the files into a client library, and deliver them digitally.

prices: 3 cents or less per two recordings

uk_legal_risk.reason: The plan includes texting agent contacts. For UK individual or sole-trader agents, unsolicited marketing texts can breach PECR unless the required consent applies.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to identifiable voice recordings and client lead data; obtain clear authorization and a lawful basis. PECR rules apply to marketing calls: automated or prerecorded marketing calls require consent, and live calls should be screened against TPS/CTPS.

idea.offer: AI services tailored to help agents make or save money, get leads, respond faster, or win listings.
idea.revenue_model: Implementation or consulting fees; pricing is not stated.

key_quotes.quote: Why don't I do this for you for free?
I can help you make or save more money or get more leads or respond faster to leads, get more listings, whatever it is.

claims.claim: The proposed introductory service would be free.

claims.claim: The speaker estimates the introductory service might cost a couple of dollars in credits.
claims.quote: It might cost you like a couple bucks in credits.

acquisition_channels.details: Use the free voicemail package as a loss leader, then offer broader AI implementation to the realtor.

ideas.delivery: Provide custom AI implementation for the realtor; the specific services and delivery process are not described.

prices: A couple of dollars in credits

ideas.other_uk_rules: If the service handles lead or customer data, UK GDPR applies. PECR rules apply to any marketing email, text, or call used to sell the service.

idea.offer: AI narration using a clone of the author's voice.
idea.revenue_model: Per-book fee; the speaker suggests $500 or a couple of thousand dollars.

key_quotes.quote: Why not like an audiobook narration service?
They don't think it's worth it because they're probably not going to sell that many.
You could charge a couple grand for this and they would still come out way ahead on savings.

idea.name: Voice cloning and dubbing for YouTube channels
idea.one_liner: Clone a YouTuber's voice and dub videos into other languages, charging creators for the work and helping them reach additional ad markets.
idea.customer: YouTubers, potentially focused on channels with 100,000 to 500,000 subscribers.

idea.revenue_model: Service fees; pricing is not stated.

uk_legal_risk.reason: The suggested email prospecting does not limit targets to UK limited companies. Cold marketing email to individual creators or sole traders is not permitted under PECR.

ideas.other_uk_rules: For UK prospects, PECR permits unsolicited marketing email to corporate subscribers with sender identification and an opt-out; UK GDPR also applies to personal data in contact lists.
